verdict.rationale: Babylon.js documents first-party physics integration with Havok, Cannon.js, Oimo.js and Ammo.js, and built-in ray casting and mesh picking. However, physics relies on separate engine plugins rather than a single built-in engine, and rigid bodies and collision handling are not described in detail. One community comment criticizes how the physics treats velocity, acceleration and world time, which lowers confidence but does not show the integration fails to work. Missing for 10: documented built-in rigid-body and collision APIs, evidence that physics works without adding a separate engine, hands-on corroboration of physics quality.

support.subject: As a game developer, built-in physics — rigid bodies, collisions, raycasts — works out of the box

citations.quote: Supports physics engines including Cannon.js, Oimo.js, and Ammo.js
